metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the parish hour, the soft supper, and the board by candle.

yesterday: The Lord Mayor sat in his pew.
Supper was peas boiled down, a sop in warm ale, and a baked apple. You complained of all three. She said the food had already yielded more than you had.
You laughed once, with a hand on the jaw.
The loaf was a penny and a full thumb short of the notch. Board was threepence. The hall candle is the firing sixpence with the washing. Upstairs candles are yours.
Evening prayer was said at the table. She said you would be in bed by eight.
